name: std::allocator_traits<Alloc>::deallocate

declarations.code: static void deallocate(Alloc &a, pointer p, size_type n);

intro: Uses the allocator a to deallocate the storage referenced by p, by calling a.deallocate(p, n).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
a

 -

 allocator to use


 p

 -

 pointer to the previously allocated storage


 n

 -

 the number of objects the storage was allocated for
